name: Vagaro
tagline: Vagaro is a scheduling and point-of-sale platform built for salons, spas, and wellness studios. Its AI assistant handles appointment booking, sends automated reminders, and suggests optimal time slots to cut down on no-shows and calendar gaps. The platform also runs payroll, inventory, and marketing campaigns from the same dashboard.
